# How much could a cash balance plan let you deduct in 2026?

> Free cash balance plan calculator for self-employed and small-practice owners aged 40+. Estimates a 2026 contribution range by age, stacked with a 401(k) and profit sharing, tax savings, employee cost and a multi-year projection. Illustrative; an actuary sets the real number. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
